translations.zh: 无论在尝试做什么，只要犯了错，我都会感到很难受。

translations.en: You might be eager to get your point across or talk about your experience, but interrupting the interviewer is awkward and rude.
translations.zh: 你也许急于表达观点或讲述经历，但打断面试官既令人尴尬，也很无礼。

translations.en: Since your baby doesn't dream at this stage of brain development, it's safe to assume babies do not have nightmares, either.
translations.zh: 由于宝宝的大脑在这一发育阶段还不会做梦，因此可以放心地认为，婴儿也不会做噩梦。

translations.en: There are mothers pushing baby carriages, old women with walkers—even in the middle of the day, when it's 90 degrees out.
translations.zh: 这里有推着婴儿车的母亲，也有借助助行器行走的老妇人——即使是在室外气温达到90度的正午也是如此。

translations.en: Third, they reprioritised, asking "Is working long hours really worth cutting back on family time?", for example.
translations.zh: 第三，他们重新安排了优先事项，例如问自己：“长时间工作真的值得牺牲与家人相处的时间吗？”

translations.en: You can share loud and proud that you won't be checking email until you're back.
translations.zh: 你可以大大方方地告诉大家，在回来之前你都不会查看电子邮件。

translations.en: Teachers with a multicultural background or training could perhaps overcome such curriculum challenges, but they're few and far between.
translations.zh: 有多元文化背景或受过相关培训的教师，也许能够应对这类课程难题，但这样的教师少之又少。

translations.en: Don't provide this even if they say they need it in order to conduct a background check.
translations.zh: 即便他们说需要这些信息来进行背景调查，也不要提供。

translations.en: After spending years fretting(烦恼) over which toys to buy, which apps to download and which skill-building programs to send their kids to after school, letting them simply play—or better yet, playing with them—could seem like a step backward.
translations.zh: 多年来，家长一直为该买哪些玩具、下载哪些应用、放学后送孩子参加哪些技能培训而烦恼，因此，现在只让孩子玩耍——或者更好些，陪他们一起玩——可能看起来像是在倒退。

translations.en: His car rolled backwards, and in a striking display of irony, hit a sign saying "Rom"--the small town in North Germany he had mistakenly plugged into the GPS system.
translations.zh: 他的汽车向后溜去，极具讽刺意味地撞上了一块写着“Rom”的路牌——那正是他误输进导航系统的德国北部小镇。

translations.en: The overall number of bacteria on the surface mattered more, and this decreased over time after the initial introduction.
translations.zh: 更重要的是表面细菌的总数，而在最初引入细菌之后，这一数量会随时间减少。

translations.en: The weakening of the human connection to nature might be good for economic growth but is bad for people.
translations.zh: 人与自然的联系减弱，也许有利于经济增长，却不利于人们自身。

translations.en: I landed badly during a fall and twisted it a little, but it's no big deal.
translations.zh: 我摔倒时落地姿势不对，稍微扭伤了一下，不过没什么大碍。

translations.en: My main problem is that my study folder is full of notes and worksheets and is badly disorganized.
translations.zh: 我的主要问题是，学习文件夹里塞满了笔记和练习纸，乱得一塌糊涂。

translations.en: Besides, I could teach him some of the basics from my time as a badminton player.
translations.zh: 此外，我以前打过羽毛球，还可以教他一些基本技巧。

translations.en: What about playing an indoor sport, like badminton?
translations.zh: 做点室内运动怎么样，比如打羽毛球？

translations.en: Our first empty sick bag against all the odds…Things were looking up.
translations.zh: 出乎意料，我们第一次没有用上晕机呕吐袋……情况开始好转了。

translations.en: P) And don't worry—whether it's a plastic bento box or a cloth bag, lunch containers can still easily be covered with popular culture.
translations.zh: P）别担心——无论是塑料便当盒还是布袋，这些午餐容器都仍然很容易装饰上流行文化元素。

translations.en: Smart companies, they believe, will try to bake more task-based planning into their strategies.
translations.zh: 他们认为，精明的公司会设法把更多以任务为中心的规划融入自身战略。

translations.en: Would I be able to sell both the vegetables and items baked from them at the festival?
translations.zh: 我能在节日期间同时出售蔬菜和用这些蔬菜制作的烘焙食品吗？

translations.en: A goal to balance suggests that things could quickly get off balance, and that causes terrible outcomes.
translations.zh: 把平衡定为目标，意味着事情可能很快就会失衡，而这会带来可怕的后果。

translations.en: Rugby is a sport with two teams, and the players carry the ball in their arms and throw it at each other.
translations.zh: 英式橄榄球是一项由两队参加的运动，球员抱着球奔跑，并把球传给队友。

translations.en: The ball is not round, and the players push each other.
translations.zh: 球不是圆的，而且球员之间会相互推挤。

translations.en: The problem has ballooned in the last 10 years, with frauds becoming more and more sophisticated.
translations.zh: 过去十年，这个问题急剧恶化，诈骗手法也越来越高明。

translations.en: Exhausted and hungry racers are greeted with delightful pies of all kinds, such as apple, orange, lemon, or banana.
translations.zh: 迎接筋疲力尽、饥肠辘辘的参赛者的，是各种美味馅饼，如苹果派、橙子派、柠檬派或香蕉派。

translations.en: The World Pipe Band Championships will take place in Glasgow on Saturday.
translations.zh: 世界风笛乐队锦标赛将于周六在格拉斯哥举行。

translations.en: The villagers finally banded together and scared the beast away with firecrackers(爆竹) and drums.
translations.zh: 村民们最终团结起来，用爆竹和鼓声吓跑了那头野兽。

translations.en: After all, by continuing to pile riches on the narrow winners, the taxpayers are not getting the maximum bang for their buck if the close losers are performing just as well or even better.
translations.zh: 毕竟，如果惜败者表现得同样出色甚至更好，继续把大量资金给那些险胜者，就无法让纳税人的钱发挥最大效益。

translations.en: Then they worked with the Kin Design Studio in Shoreditch, met designers at their school and attended a lunch with Deutsche Bank employees.
translations.zh: 随后，他们与肖尔迪奇的Kin设计工作室合作，在学校会见了设计师，还与德意志银行的员工共进午餐。

translations.en: The person who worked in the bank is more likely ready, willing and able to be part of the team and do the job from day 1.
translations.zh: 有过银行工作经验的人，更有可能从第一天起就准备好、愿意且有能力融入团队并开展工作。

translations.en: Support Bill Perry's pub, and any other bar or restaurant that doesn't ask you to do drunken math.
translations.zh: 请支持比尔·佩里的酒馆，以及所有不要求你醉着算账的酒吧和餐馆。

translations.en: Snack lovers are panic buying, and many supermarket shelves are bare.
translations.zh: 零食爱好者正恐慌性抢购，许多超市的货架已经空了。

translations.en: Shopping for food involved mud, noisy chickens, clouds of flies, nasty smells, bargaining, and getting short-changed.
translations.zh: 买菜意味着泥泞、吵闹的鸡、成群的苍蝇、难闻的气味、讨价还价，还可能被少找钱。

translations.en: The spread of no-fault divorce has reduced the bargaining power of whichever spouse is more interested in continuing the relationship.
translations.zh: 无过错离婚的普及，削弱了夫妻中更想维持婚姻一方的谈判筹码。

translations.en: And although you don't read about this much, the United States is also a large exporter of oil products, selling about 2 million barrels of petroleum products per day to about 90 countries.
translations.zh: 虽然你很少读到这方面的报道，但美国也是石油产品出口大国，每天向约90个国家出售大约200万桶石油产品。

translations.en: Captain Cook gave the island its European name, because it acts as a barrier between the Pacific and the Hauraki Gulf.
translations.zh: 库克船长给这座岛取了如今的欧洲名称，因为它在太平洋和豪拉基湾之间起着屏障作用。

translations.en: Low-income households report that they find it difficult to adopt dietary guidelines because food prices are a barrier to improving their diets.
translations.zh: 低收入家庭表示，他们很难遵循膳食指南，因为食品价格是改善饮食的障碍。

translations.en: "Other than they're both cars, the Nascar fan base is a very different fan base," Carey said.
translations.zh: “除了比的都是汽车，纳斯卡的车迷群体与另一方的车迷群体非常不同，”凯里说。

translations.en: Big houses are advertised as a reward for hard work and diligence, turning housing from a basic necessity into a luxury.
translations.zh: 广告把大房子描绘成努力工作和勤奋的回报，将住房从基本必需品变成了奢侈品。

translations.en: Earlier this year, Matthew Ricci told gaming site Kotaku: "If you're playing EVE Online you basically already have an MBA."
translations.zh: 今年早些时候，马修·里奇告诉游戏网站Kotaku：“如果你在玩《星战前夜》，基本上就已经相当于有了MBA学位。”

translations.en: Basically, she miscalculated how fast she was burning through the money, and she's now full of regret.
translations.zh: 说白了，她错估了花钱的速度，如今后悔不已。

translations.en: Michigan is the only state that prohibits discrimination on the basis of weight and height.
translations.zh: 密歇根州是唯一禁止基于体重和身高实施歧视的州。

translations.en: The basis for each of these things, however, is whether or not you are willing to make a compromise when it comes to changing your name.
translations.zh: 不过，这些事情的基础，都在于面对改姓问题时，你是否愿意作出妥协。

translations.en: That's why I picked it up from the waste paper basket and left it on the desk.
translations.zh: 所以我才把它从废纸篓里捡起来，放在桌上。

translations.en: Maybe he could even join the school basketball team when he's ready.
translations.zh: 也许等他准备好了，甚至可以加入学校篮球队。

translations.en: My daughter's stock answers are basketball player, pop singer, mechanical engineer.
translations.zh: 我女儿惯常的回答是：篮球运动员、流行歌手、机械工程师。

translations.en: Unlike bats, birds and fish, however, humans have difficulty judging distances behind them.
translations.zh: 不过，人类与蝙蝠、鸟类和鱼类不同，很难判断身后物体的距离。

translations.en: Presenting a water bowl to a Savannah may also prove a challenge, as some will promptly begin to bat all the water out of the bowl until it is empty, using their front paws.
translations.zh: 给萨凡纳猫准备一碗水也可能是一项挑战，因为有些猫会立刻用前爪把碗里的水全部拍出去，直到碗空了为止。

translations.en: Pain-relieving creams don't work, but a hot shower or warm bath can provide some relief.
translations.zh: 止痛膏不起作用，但洗个热水澡或泡个温水浴能有所缓解。

translations.en: Betsan Corkhill, a wellness coach in Bath, England, and author of the book Knit for Health & Wellness, established a website, Stitchlinks, to explore the value of what she calls therapeutic knitting.
translations.zh: 贝特桑·科克希尔是英国巴斯的一名健康教练，也是《编织有益健康与幸福》一书的作者；她创办了Stitchlinks网站，探索她所称的“治疗性编织”的价值。

translations.en: If you're like most people, you end up buying the large (and taking a bathroom break midshow).
translations.zh: 如果你和大多数人一样，最后就会买大杯的，并在演出中途去一趟洗手间。

translations.en: Some began to stop taking bathroom breaks, worried that if their productivity fell they would be fired.
translations.zh: 有些人开始连厕所都不去，担心工作效率下降会导致自己被解雇。

translations.en: Although ebikes first appeared in the 90s, cheaper options and longer-lasting batteries are breathing new life into the concept.
translations.zh: 尽管电动自行车早在20世纪90年代就已出现，但价格更实惠的车型和续航更长的电池，正使这一概念重新焕发生机。

translations.en: Another time, he cancelled a date with his girlfriend at the last minute telling her he had to get a new battery for his truck.
translations.zh: 还有一次，他临时取消了与女友的约会，告诉她自己必须去给卡车换一块新电池。

translations.en: One start-up is convinced that the skills learned by playing games — hard-won through years of training and battle — can be applied to real-life work situations.
translations.zh: 一家初创公司坚信，通过多年训练和对战辛苦学来的游戏技能，可以应用于现实的工作场景。

translations.en: A German supermarket has been ordered to destroy its chocolate rabbits after it lost a court battle with a Swiss chocolate manufacturer.
translations.zh: 一家德国超市在与瑞士巧克力制造商的诉讼中败诉后，被命令销毁其巧克力兔子。

translations.en: We also loved visiting the potter(陶艺家) Sarah Harrison, who showed us round her studio at Shoal Bay harbour, and her many pots and jugs, plates and bowls and colourful mosaics(马赛克).
translations.zh: 我们也很喜欢拜访陶艺家莎拉·哈里森，她带我们参观了她位于肖尔湾港的工作室，以及她制作的许多陶罐、水壶、盘子、碗和彩色马赛克作品。

translations.en: Eating pancakes on the balcony overlooking the unspoilt white sandy beach was a great way to start the day.
translations.zh: 在阳台上吃着薄煎饼，眺望那片未受破坏的白色沙滩，是开启一天的绝佳方式。

translations.en: He was trapped under a beam about 10 feet below the surface for nearly an hour and a half.
translations.zh: 他被困在地面以下约10英尺的一根横梁下，时间将近一个半小时。

translations.en: Everything from specialist cheeses to sought-after coffee beans, gets thrown away every day in the current food system.
translations.zh: 在当前的食品体系中，从特色奶酪到备受追捧的咖啡豆，各种食物每天都被丢弃。

translations.en: Beans are an especially excellent protein substitute.
translations.zh: 豆类尤其适合作为蛋白质的替代来源。

translations.en: Bear in mind they will last me several years and they are very fashionable too.
translations.zh: 别忘了，它们够我用好几年，而且也很时尚。

translations.en: Please bear in mind that the price includes moving all the furniture, and the whole task would take two days.
translations.zh: 请记住，价格包含搬动所有家具的费用，整个工程需要两天。

translations.en: As is so often the case, clever marketing can beat reason; awareness is rarely enough.
translations.zh: 正如常见的情况那样，巧妙的营销能够战胜理性；仅仅意识到问题，往往还不够。

translations.en: "So what they believe is that their children must excel and beat their white peers in academic settings so they have the same chances to excel later."
translations.zh: “因此他们认为，孩子必须在学业上出类拔萃，胜过白人同龄人，日后才有同等的机会取得成功。”

translations.en: "The more creative we are, the more beautiful and delicious our future will be."
translations.zh: “我们越有创造力，未来就会越美好、越美味。”

translations.en: In many cases, learning for the sake of learning can be a beautiful thing.
translations.zh: 在许多情况下，单纯为了学习本身而学习，是一件很美好的事。

translations.en: Trying to look like the magazine pictures can take us on a long ride away from what beauty is really about.
translations.zh: 努力让自己看起来像杂志上的照片，可能会让我们离美的真正内涵越来越远。

translations.en: Yet slipping from popular culture is the wonder and beauty of the natural world.
translations.zh: 然而，自然界的奇妙与美丽正逐渐淡出流行文化。

translations.en: Because there is a delayed satisfaction associated with self-control, it can be easy to get off track.
translations.zh: 由于自我控制带来的满足是延迟的，人们很容易偏离原定方向。

translations.en: Team-building exercises have become popular for managers trying to increase organisational and team harmony and productivity.
translations.zh: 为了提高组织和团队的和谐程度与生产效率，管理者越来越喜欢组织团队建设活动。

translations.en: Over the next century, he predicted, the economy would become so productive that people would barely need to work at all.
translations.zh: 他预言，在接下来的一个世纪里，经济生产效率将大幅提高，人们几乎完全不需要工作。

translations.en: Lying in bed, eyes closed, one female patient on the tape performs the dance moves she learned earlier.
translations.zh: 录像中，一名女患者闭着双眼躺在床上，做出了她先前学过的舞蹈动作。

translations.en: After I fell out of my bed twice during my freshman year, the university installed a railing—for $20, billed to my student account.
translations.zh: 大一时我两次从床上摔下来，后来学校安装了护栏——费用20美元，记在我的学生账户上。

translations.en: Organic farmers never use neonics, the controversial pesticides that have been linked to shrinking bee populations worldwide.
translations.zh: 有机农户从不使用新烟碱类农药；这类备受争议的杀虫剂被认为与全球蜜蜂数量减少有关。

translations.en: Dorchester County is aware that some beekeepers in the area that was sprayed on Sunday lost their bee colonies.
translations.zh: 多切斯特县已获悉，在周日接受喷药的地区，一些养蜂人损失了自己的蜂群。

translations.en: Meatless meats are generally a healthier choice than beef because they are cholesterol-free, plus they're a good source of vitamins, minerals, protein, and fiber.
translations.zh: 植物仿肉通常比牛肉更健康，因为它不含胆固醇，同时还是维生素、矿物质、蛋白质和膳食纤维的良好来源。

translations.en: I think we should get some beer and wine and some fruit juice and other soft drinks.
translations.zh: 我觉得我们应该买些啤酒、葡萄酒、果汁和其他软饮料。

translations.en: Pay a little more up front for your beer or burger.
translations.zh: 买啤酒或汉堡时，一开始就多付一点钱。

translations.en: Before you can get somebody on-board with your goal, you should help them understand why they should pursue it.
translations.zh: 在让别人认同你的目标之前，你应该帮助他们明白为什么值得追求这个目标。

translations.en: Kids would beg for a new lunch box every year to keep up with the newest characters, even if their old lunchbox was perfectly usable.
translations.zh: 为了追赶最新的卡通角色潮流，孩子们每年都会缠着父母买新饭盒，即使旧饭盒还完全能用。

translations.en: Christine Marshall, a 34-year-old mum of one posted a tearful video on social media, Wednesday, begging for the safe return of her beloved pet dog.
translations.zh: 周三，34岁、育有一个孩子的母亲克里斯蒂娜·马歇尔在社交媒体上发布了一段含泪的视频，恳求她心爱的宠物狗能够平安归来。

translations.en: We need a more informed way of discussing behavior that at first we cannot, or should not, begin to understand.
translations.zh: 对于那些起初我们无法、或不应贸然声称理解的行为，我们需要以更充分了解情况的方式来讨论。

translations.en: Because when you are enjoying, people around you will begin to enjoy as well.
translations.zh: 因为当你享受其中时，身边的人也会开始乐在其中。

translations.en: Some people are beginning to wonder whether opera and classical music are still relevant to the modern world of music.
translations.zh: 一些人开始怀疑，歌剧和古典音乐是否仍与现代音乐世界息息相关。

translations.en: Let's start back at the beginning of the 20th century—the beginning of the lunch box story, really.
translations.zh: 让我们从20世纪初说起——严格说来，那正是饭盒故事的起点。

translations.en: In May, the American Civil Liberties Union (ACLU) and Outten & Golden LLP announced a historic class-action $5m settlement with JPMorgan Chase on behalf of male employees who claim they were illegally denied access to paid parental leave.
translations.zh: 5月，美国公民自由联盟与Outten & Golden律师事务所宣布，代表那些声称被非法剥夺带薪育儿假权利的男性雇员，与摩根大通达成了一项具有历史意义、金额为500万美元的集体诉讼和解。

translations.en: They found that when people compete against their rivals, they are more willing to behave unethically to win.
translations.zh: 他们发现，当人们与自己的劲敌竞争时，会更愿意为了获胜而采取不道德的行为。

translations.en: We need to teach children how to behave like the professionals they're striving to become.
translations.zh: 我们需要教孩子如何像他们努力成为的专业人士那样行事。

translations.en: According to evolutionary scientists, cooperative behavior may have evolved first among relatives to promote the continuation of their genetic line.
translations.zh: 进化科学家认为，合作行为可能最早在亲属之间进化形成，以促进自身遗传谱系的延续。

translations.en: Importantly, there were also some promising effects of the new intervention on actual behavior.
translations.zh: 重要的是，这种新的干预措施在实际行为上也显示出了一些令人鼓舞的效果。

translations.en: With the U.S. lagging behind other countries in academics, it's time to consider year-round schooling.
translations.zh: 美国的学业表现落后于其他国家，是时候考虑全年制教学了。

translations.en: Symphonic orchestra compositions have also been created solely for the purpose of being included in major motion pictures.

translations.zh: 但让本能主导决定，到底有多明智呢？

translations.en: Craftsmen have helped educate consumers to make wise choices.
translations.zh: 工匠们帮助消费者增长知识，做出明智的选择。

translations.en: But the woman says the snake she encountered Thursday terrified her out of her wits.
translations.zh: 不过，这名女性说，她周四遇到的那条蛇把她吓得魂飞魄散。

translations.en: The first month I did withdraw extra cash twice, but I felt guilty about it.
translations.zh: 第一个月，我确实额外取过两次现金，但心里感到内疚。

translations.zh: 我得去趟银行，取一些现金。

translations.en: Their ability to withstand almost any disaster makes them seem like something out of a comic book.
translations.zh: 它们几乎能承受任何灾难的能力，让它们看起来像是漫画里的东西。

translations.en: We're now witnessing the emergence of an advanced economy based on information and knowledge.
translations.zh: 我们正见证一种以信息和知识为基础的先进经济形态的出现。

translations.en: Witnesses said people were looking on in horror as the child's mother, identified by sources as Maria Zamara, stood frozen in shock.
translations.zh: 目击者说，人们惊恐地看着，而孩子的母亲则因震惊而僵在原地；消息人士称她名叫 Maria Zamara。

translations.en: One is next to a small, elderly woman; the other is next to a muscular, fierce-looking man.
translations.zh: 一个座位挨着一位身材娇小的老妇人，另一个则挨着一名肌肉发达、长相凶悍的男人。

translations.en: Throughout history, governments have protected and promoted forests for diverse reasons, ranging from the need for wooden warships to a desire to promote suburban house-building.
translations.zh: 纵观历史，各国政府出于各种原因保护并培育森林，从建造木制战舰的需要，到推动郊区住宅建设的愿望，不一而足。

translations.en: One can also paint the wooden frameworks the same color as the walls.
translations.zh: 也可以把木框架漆成与墙壁相同的颜色。

translations.zh: 他们可以看绵羊剪毛，并了解羊毛如何被制成衣服。

translations.en: "The biggest thing I took away from the workshop is learning how to be more 'inclusive' to differences."
translations.zh: “我在这次工作坊最大的收获，是学会如何对差异更加‘包容’。”

translations.zh: “对我们的生意来说，自行车道造成的影响比新冠疫情糟得多。”

translations.en: According to one survey, only 26% of Americans volunteer, despite reports that many Americans view volunteering as worthwhile.
translations.zh: 一项调查显示，只有26%的美国人参与志愿服务，尽管有报告称，许多美国人认为志愿服务很有价值。

translations.en: Having been alone for a bit, you will also appreciate your friends' company more, and chances are, your time spent together will be more worthwhile.
translations.zh: 独处一段时间后，你也会更加珍惜朋友的陪伴，而且你们共处的时光很可能更有价值。

translations.en: Also, remember a successful ending is not the only thing worthy of a celebration.
translations.zh: 还有，记住，成功的结局并不是唯一值得庆祝的事。

translations.en: "Here he comes, and he wound up in my back seat before I could finally get off the road, stop and get out of the car."
translations.zh: “他就这样过来了，在我终于驶离道路、停好车并下车之前，他就已经到了我的后座上。”

translations.en: "It is like having these open wounds—they are just a part of you," he says.
translations.zh: 他说：“这就像身上有这些敞开的伤口，它们就是你的一部分。”

translations.en: Natural disasters can wreck a community's infrastructure, disrupting systems for months or years.
translations.zh: 自然灾害会破坏社区的基础设施，让各个系统中断数月，甚至数年。

translations.en: The Olympic got wrecked before the Titanic did, but it was the only one to survive and maintain a successful career of 24 years.
translations.zh: 奥林匹克号比泰坦尼克号更早遭遇事故，但它却是唯一幸存下来、并成功服役24年的船。

translations.en: Irene continued this work by developing X-ray facilities for military in France and Belgium.
translations.zh: Irene 继续这项工作，为法国和比利时军方建设X光设施。

translations.en: It's possible to drive in a matter of minutes from sleek(光亮的) office towers near the airport where people pitch ideas to investors, to single-family homes with orange trees in their yards, or to a Vietnamese mall.
translations.zh: 人们可以在短短几分钟内，开车从机场附近光鲜的办公楼——在那里人们向投资者推介创意——到达院子里种着橙树的独栋住宅，或一座越南风格的购物中心。

translations.en: In fact, as one of the most damaging invasive species on the continent, wild pigs caused millions of dollars in crop damage yearly.
translations.zh: 事实上，野猪作为这片大陆破坏性最强的入侵物种之一，每年给农作物造成数百万美元的损失。

translations.en: For comparison, let's say you wanted to "jam" a conversation between two people—all you'd need to do is yell in the listener's ear.
translations.zh: 作个比较，假如你想“干扰”两个人的谈话，只需要对着听者的耳朵大喊。

translations.en: It's about an hour outside Seoul, built on former tidal flats along the Yellow Sea.
translations.zh: 它距离首尔约一小时车程，建在黄海沿岸原先的滩涂上。

translations.en: Yesterday two male and three female tourists were spotted walking the kilometer-long beach, picking up trash.
translations.zh: 昨天，有人看见两名男游客和三名女游客沿着一公里长的海滩行走，捡拾垃圾。

translations.zh: 第二，小麦和水稻的单产增幅，一直低于玉米和大豆。

translations.zh: 研究人员认为，这座动物园最初的动物，是从一个叫作蓬特的遥远地区带回来的。
